senses.gloss: m. (τρίμετρος) trimeter, a verse (or tune) of three iambic meters.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Rosh Hashanah 4:10:2">Y. R. Hash. IV, 59ᶜ</cite> bot. (defining <cite ref="E00891"><he>הֲרָעָה</he></cite>) [read:] <he>כאהן ט׳</he> like the trimeter (short-long, short-long &c.), contrad. to <he>תלת דקיקן</he> three small (short) notes.
